selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq installed and configured on node1 with address=/inventory-api.internal/10.100.121.11; listening on node1's IP; firewall opened; dig from node1 confirms inventory-api.internal -> 10.100.121.11 and external names still resolve

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 configured to use node1 as DNS resolver for internal lookups
selected_evidence.summary: NetworkManager connection on node2 set with ipv4.dns=10.100.121.10, ignore-auto-dns=yes; /etc/resolv.conf shows nameserver 10.100.121.10; dig on node2 (no explicit server) resolves inventory-api.internal to 10.100.121.11 and external domains successfully

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; node1 unreachable during reboot; reconnected with new boot_id 2c6cd2d4... confirming restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart service recovery (first reboot revealed and fixed a boot-race)
selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq found failed post-reboot due to DHCP address race; diagnosed via journal; fixed with systemd override (network-online.target dependency + Restart=on-failure); verified dnsmasq active, firewall rules persisted, and DNS resolution (internal+external) restored

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart fix verified durable via second reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Second reboot of node1 acknowledged and completed; new boot_id 869ef798... confirms restart; dnsmasq and firewalld came up active automatically with correct DNS resolution, confirming the override fix persists across restarts
Captured node2 boot_id 583ddd53... and confirmed resolv.conf/DNS resolution working before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 unreachable during reboot; reconnected with new boot_id 0f3f42a5... confirming restart; post-restart resolv.conf still points to node1, and inventory-api.internal plus external DNS resolve correctly

sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/dnsmasq.service.d
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/dnsmasq.service.d/override.conf
[Unit]
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable network-online.target 2>&1
sudo systemctl restart dnsmasq
systemctl is-active dnsmasq
